messages:
anya: Heads-up 1: SableWorks interview confirmed for Tue Apr 8 10:30am PT. Aim: 1) short launch blog, 2) 30s promo cut, 3) product page testimonial. Need quote + logo permission by Mon Apr 7 EOD.

rory: Nice. I'll own the recording + clips. Quick Q: do they want an embargo? They mentioned a partner announcement that week.

jess: I'll own the copy and the PR sync. Rory, please capture a clean 4:3 and 16:9 frame for assets. If embargoed, we'll hold the post until partner ok.

marie: Legal check: please avoid unverified customer numbers. If they give % improvements, have them confirm "internal metrics" or get written permission. Also ask for written logo usage rights (vector preferred).

anya: Draft customer quote to propose (please edit):
```
"Using Redwood Inference let us add live summarization to our support workflows, improving resolution time without changing our backend architecture." 1 Lina R., Head of Product, SableWorks
```
Can PR + Legal review and flag.

rory: Suggest tightening: change "improving resolution time" -> "reducing average handle time by 18%" only if they confirm the stat. Otherwise keep generic.

jess: I'll send the quote plus logo request to Lina now. Template message: > Hey Lina 1 thanks for taking time. Can you confirm the quote below and confirm we can use SableWorks logo on the post and product page? Also let us know if the 18% stat is publishable or for internal use only.

pr-bot: Reminder scheduled: "SableWorks case study outgoing email" Mon Apr 7 09:00am PT

marie: If they approve numbers, we'll need a short license line added: "Approved for public release by SableWorks on [date]" and PR to keep a copy of the signed permission email.

anya: Headline options (pick reaction):
1) Product-led: "SableWorks adds live summarization with Redwood Inference"
2) Outcome-led: "SableWorks reduces support time and launches live summaries"
React :one: or :two:.

rory: Also thinking a 90s webinar could follow. Draft blurb: "See how SableWorks scaled live features with Redwood 1 live demo + lessons learned." Good to have a promo in the toolkit.

jess: Sent the message to Lina (DM). Pasting reply when it comes.

marie: Legal note: if they request redlines, route them to legal@redwood.example and cc PR. Avoid any absolutes like "always" / "never" in quotes.

anya: Timeline:
- Today: PR (Jess) sends quote + logo request
- Mon Apr 7 EOD: Customer approval + legal ok
- Tue Apr 8: Interview + asset capture
- Thu Apr 10: Draft post + 30s clip for internal review
Please flag blockers.

rory: Will add timestamps/chapters and upload clips to /shared/marketing/sableworks once done.

jess: Lina replied in DM: "Happy to approve the quote and the 18% stat. We can share the logo (SVG). Please do not publish until Apr 15 to align with partner." Pasting full reply to thread once I copy.

anya: Great 1 that means embargo til Apr 15. We'll schedule publish accordingly. Jess, can you get the written ok for logo use?

jess: She attached the SVG and a short line: "Approved for public release Apr 15 by SableWorks legal." I'll shove the file into the shared drive and cc legal.

marie: Received the approval line. I'll log it and sign off once I see the final quote text in the post.

anya: Ok team 1 actions: Jess -> upload assets + paste customer approval; Marie -> confirm legal sign-off after copy; Rory -> record + tag clips; Anya -> finalize launch cadence and queue embargoed publish for Apr 15.

rory: All good. Will capture 30s and 2m cuts and mark a 15s social teaser.

jess: Upload done, Lina's quote is slightly edited to remove product names 1 she approved final wording. Pasting: 
> "Redwood let us ship live summarization quickly and cut average support handle time by 18%." 1 Lina R., Head of Product, SableWorks

marie: Legal sign-off: confirmed. Add footer "Approved for public release by SableWorks, Apr 15 2025." PR can proceed to schedule.

anya: Thanks all. Will create the publish ticket in Asana and assign reviewers. :sparkles:

(End of thread — internal notes and final assets stored under /shared/marketing/sableworks)
